object.description: Leave index.lock in the git folder and commit a change through the library and through the Document Editor's service with a raised issue; separately have another program create index.lock while the commit writes the index. Expected: no commit is made and HEAD doesn't move; the error says the index is locked; once the lock is gone, committing again commits the change (and cuts the issue).
